text: I am going to Jesus, stopping what I am doing in that moment, and saying, Please forgive me and receive me. Lord, you could make Daniel so faithful to you that even death could not turn him from your commandments. I want to have that experience. I want to break free from the cycle of sin.

repent, sin, get up, repentance. I want to know freedom in Jesus. [snorts] How many of you want to say, Lord, this week, begin to show me what that means. Show me what it means. I am willing to do whatever it takes, but I need you to reveal to me and to give me power to obey your commands, whatever they may be. That's that's that's calling for a decision. Do I need to make that simpler? Yeah, I should make that simpler. What's the call? The call is, do you this week, even today, right now,

Lord, I believe that you can keep me like you kept Daniel. This week I want to know victory in Jesus. I want to stop excusing my sins. Lord, give me power to obey you and to live a life that will honor you for all that you have done.

I want to fear you this week, that is, respect you. I want to glorify you and truly worship you. Despite all that I have done and may still do in the future, heaven's arms are open wide and all heaven is on my side. Thank you for this beautiful hope that we have in Jesus.
Help us without delay to come to your throne of grace and to believe that you will make us as white as snow. Help us this week, Lord, to experience your power.

We want to know victory in Jesus. Help us to know your power even in our weakest areas where normally we are overcome. May we see you working in us and through us. We thank you for your goodness and mercy despite our unworthiness. In Jesus' name, amen. Music, singing, heat, heat.
Heat. Music and singing. Such deep, such a heaven to redeem us is all. O brother, be faithful. The city of God prepared for the good and the blessed. Time's dark night of sorrow is wearing away.
O brother, be faithful. He soon will descend. O brother, be faithful, and soon shall thy Savior pronounce the word: Well done, faithful servant; enter the joy of the Lord.
Eternity shall tell all thy faithfulness now. Bright songs of gladness. Be faithful and promise to show that waits for the faithful, and ever with Jesus abide.

For those wondering why we sang this song after a message mostly about forgiveness, it is because forgiveness should produce in us a willingness to be faithful to Christ unto the end. Let us pray. Keep us as we travel and bless us. In Jesus' name, amen. King of my life, I crown thee now; thine shall the glory be.
Lest I forget thy thorn-crowned brow, lead me to Calvary. Lest I forget thy love for me, lead me to Calvary. Show me the tomb where thou wast laid, tenderly mourned and wept.

Let me like Mary through the gloom come with a gift to thee. Show to me now the empty tomb. May I be willing, Lord, to bear daily my cross for thee. Even thy cup of grief to share, thou hast borne all for me.
Lest I forget thy love for me. Lead me to Calvary. Music.
